summary: A Hammersmith aesthetic clinic established in 2001 appears to lose bookings to a broken email link, a free builder address and a 2015 footer.

findings.problem: The email address appears with a space after the at sign, and the email link appears to be cut to info@g.
findings.cost: Patients who tap the email link reach no one, and you never see the lost enquiry.
findings.fix: A working email link and a booking form.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a clinic that does injectables.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the clinic may not be active.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: The text Hammersmith Clini appears cut off, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Cut off text looks careless and patients cannot message quickly.
